name: github
description: Read GitHub issues and feature roadmaps (Projects) via GitHub's official hosted MCP server. Read-only endpoint, personal-access-token auth.

connection.instructions:
Connect with a GitHub **personal access token** — the MCP server only ever sees repositories and Projects your own token can access.

1. On GitHub, open **Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained tokens** (or *Tokens (classic)*).
2. Click **Generate new token**. Grant read access to the repositories whose issues and Projects you want to surface (fine-grained: *Issues → Read-only* and *Projects → Read-only*; classic: the `repo` and `read:project` scopes).
3. Copy the token and paste it below.

We call the read-only GitHub MCP endpoint, so the token is never used to write.

fields.name: GITHUB_PAT
fields.label: GitHub personal access token
fields.helpText: Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens. Needs read access to Issues and Projects.
